notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

In this update, we have changed the joystick controls and removed the cursor. Now it’s much easier to play if you're using a joystick!

Here's a summary of what's new:
[list]
[*] Improved joystick controls
[*] Camera movement follows the cursor (using keyboard and mouse)
[*] Dialogues and interactions no longer block character movement
[*] Objectives only appear when the backpack is open
[*] Shortcut (B or RMB) to quickly store items
[*] More control tips
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

Let us know what you think!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Best Brazilian Game of the Year
notes.notes:
Great News!

Like No Other (LNO) was nominated for the category "Best Brazilian Game of the Year" at the prestigious Big Festival!

We're grateful to be recognized alongside talented developers in Brazil.

Stay tuned for more updates.

Have fun :)
Actoon Team

notes.title: Like No Other is OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
We are happy announce that our new game "Like No Other: The Legend Of The Twin Books" is out!! It was made with love and care.

It tells a story of Dan a man who finally decides to live his dream of being a treasure hunter.

Have fun :)
Actoon Team
